integrity: All numerical values in the finding are recomputed by the bundled standalone verifier; finite computations are presented only as checks, not as proofs of the all-sample-size statements.
scientific_limitations: Exact finite-sample statements require iid Gaussian observations and exactly one ordinary nonparametric bootstrap resample. The proof does not cover non-Gaussian data, multiple resamples, or studentized/calibrated variants. Originality searches cannot exclude terminology-divergent older literature.
title: Exact Gaussian coverage law for the one-resample Cheap Bootstrap
